diagnosis.note: No sentences in the document are labelled Diagnosis; the text moves directly from a statement of what the specification covers to the proposal and implementation detail, without articulating a problem, its causes, effects or scale.

core_themes.name: Modern languages as a rigorous interdisciplinary subject
core_themes.claim: The study of a modern language is an interdisciplinary subject offering the same cognitive and academic advantages as other humanities disciplines.

core_themes.name: Broad transferable benefits
core_themes.claim: Beyond practical language skills, AS/A level modern languages content builds intercultural competence and transferable skills (communication, critical thinking, autonomy, creativity, cognitive flexibility) valuable to individuals, society, higher education and employers.

core_themes.name: Relevance to all students
core_themes.claim: The content is designed to be of value to students of all disciplines, not only those intending further study in the subject.

core_themes.name: Foundation for degree-level study
core_themes.claim: The specification provides a robust foundation for students wishing to progress to degree-level or equivalent study of a modern language.

core_themes.name: Comprehensive linguistic and cognitive skill development
core_themes.claim: AS and A level specifications must require students to develop a broad range of linguistic, cultural, critical-thinking and transferable skills through structured language learning outcomes.

core_themes.name: Thematic study using authentic sources
core_themes.claim: Specifications must require study of prescribed themes relating to society and culture through authentic spoken and written sources, including online media.

core_themes.name: Study of literary works and film
core_themes.claim: Students must study prescribed literary works and/or films and demonstrate critical understanding and response to them in the language of study, with greater depth required at A level.

core_themes.name: Independent research skills at A level
core_themes.claim: A level specifications must additionally require students to develop and demonstrate independent research skills in the language of study.

core_themes.name: Detailed grammar specification by language
core_themes.claim: Specifications must include detailed, comparable grammar content lists for French, German and Spanish, with other languages required to develop appendices of comparable challenge and breadth.

core_themes.name: Chinese-specific adaptations
core_themes.claim: Because Chinese differs structurally from other languages covered, its AS/A level expectations include specific exceptions, such as English-language comprehension questions, that differ from the standard implementation model.

implementation.note: The implementation aspect comprises a package of distinct delivery requirements (skills, themes, literary study, research, grammar, and a language-specific exception for Chinese) rather than a single unified method.
